sections.CPU: AMD Socket AM4, support for: AMD Ryzen™ 5000 G-Series Processors/ AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series Processors/ AMD Ryzen™ 4000 G-Series Processors/ AMD Ryzen™ 3000 and Ryzen™ 3000 G-Series Processors (Please refer "CPU Support List" for more information.)
sections.Memory: 2 x DDR4 DIMM sockets supporting up to 64 GB (32 GB single DIMM capacity) of system memory Support for DDR4 5100(O.C.) / 4800(O.C.) / 4600(O.C.) / 4400(O.C.) / 4266(O.C.) / 4133(O.C.) / 4000(O.C.) / 3866(O.C.) / 3733(O.C.) / 3600(O.C.) / 3466(O.C) / 3400(O.C.) / 3200 / 2933 / 2667 / 2400 / 2133 MHz memory modules Dual channel memory architecture Support for ECC Un-buffered DIMM 1Rx8/2Rx8 memory modules (operate in non-ECC mode) Support for non-ECC Un-buffered DIMM 1Rx8/2Rx8/1Rx16 memory modules Support for Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory modules (The CPU and memory configuration may affect the supported memory types, data rate (speed), and number of DRAM modules, please refer to "Memory Support List" on GIGABYTE's website for more information.)
sections.Onboard Graphics: Integrated Graphics Processor with AMD Radeon™ Graphics support: 1 x D-Sub port, supporting a maximum resolution of 1920x1200@60 Hz 1 x HDMI port, supporting a maximum resolution of 4096x2160@60 Hz * Support for HDMI 2.1 version, HDCP 2.3, and HDR. (Graphics specifications may vary depending on CPU support.) Maximum shared memory of 16 GB
sections.Audio: Realtek ® Audio CODEC High Definition Audio 2/4/5.1/7.1-channel * You can change the functionality of an audio jack using the audio software. To configure 7.1-channel audio, access the audio software for audio settings.
sections.LAN: Realtek® GbE LAN chip (1 Gbps/100 Mbps/10 Mbps)
sections.Expansion Slots: CPU: 1 x PCI Express x16 slot, supporting PCIe 3.0 and running at x16 Chipset: 1 x PCI Express x1 slot, supporting PCIe 3.0 and running at x1
sections.Storage Interface: CPU: 1 x M.2 connector (Socket 3, M key, type 2280 SATA and PCIe 3.0 x4/x2 SSD support) Chipset: 4 x SATA 6Gb/s connectors Support for RAID 0, RAID 1, and RAID 10
sections.USB: CPU: 4 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports on the back panel Chipset: 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports available through the internal USB header 6 x USB 2.0/1.1 ports (2 ports on the back panel, 4 ports available through the internal USB headers)
sections.Internal I/O Connectors: 1 x 24-pin ATX main power connector 1 x 8-pin ATX 12V power connector 1 x CPU fan header 1 x system fan header 1 x M.2 Socket 3 connector 4 x SATA 6Gb/s connectors 1 x front panel header 1 x front panel audio header 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 header 2 x USB 2.0/1.1 headers 1 x Trusted Platform Module (TPM) header (2x6 pin, for the GC-TPM2.0_S module only) 1 x speaker header 1 x Clear CMOS jumper 1 x chassis intrusion header
sections.Back Panel Connectors: 1 x PS/2 keyboard/mouse port 1 x D-Sub port 1 x HDMI port 4 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports 2 x USB 2.0/1.1 ports 1 x RJ-45 port 3 x audio jacks
sections.H/W Monitoring: Voltage detection Temperature detection Fan speed detection Fan fail warning Fan speed control * Whether the fan speed control function is supported will depend on the cooler you install.
sections.BIOS: 1 x 128 Mbit flash Use of licensed AMI UEFI BIOS PnP 1.0a, DMI 2.7, WfM 2.0, SM BIOS 2.7, ACPI 5.0
sections.Unique Features: Support for APP Center * Available applications in APP Center may vary by motherboard model. Supported functions of each application may also vary depending on motherboard specifications. @BIOS EasyTune Smart Backup System Information Viewer Support for Q-Flash
sections.Bundled Software: Norton ® Internet Security (OEM version) LAN bandwidth management software * Service discontinued as a result of contract termination by the software provider.
sections.Operating System: Support for Windows 11 64-bit Support for Windows 10 64-bit
sections.Remark: Due to different Linux support condition provided by chipset vendors, please download Linux driver from chipset vendors' website or 3rd party website. Most hardware/software vendors may no longer offer drivers to support Win9X/ME/2000/XP. If drivers are available from the vendors, we will update them on the GIGABYTE website.
